name: Slingshot
description:
This bow gains a [brown]sling[/brown], a 9-slot [effect:inv][dark-gray]item inventory[/dark-gray][/effect] which can hold non-equipment items. Shooting without any arrows instead fires items from the [brown]sling[/brown], applying unique effects such as:

  • Blocks deal damage based on hardness.

  • Glass shatters, dealing 50% radial damage.

  • Light-emitting blocks make targets glow.

  • Food is fed to the target.

effects.explanation: Open the item's inventory by right clicking it in your inventory.
